description: Na₂MgMn₄O₈ crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅4m2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.64 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight equivalent MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.34 Å. Mg is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Mg-O bond lengths are 2.01 Å. Mn is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four equivalent MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.16 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three equivalent Mn atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Mg, and two equivalent Mn atoms.
